note: Picture-provider capability records read by shot_router.capabilities (3E.3). These are data on file, not code: the newest GPT-image model may be overridden by an image catalog handed to picture_capability(). A provider with takes_reference_images false cannot draw a known character and is refused PROVIDER_CANNOT_HOLD_CHARACTER.
